title: The visionary initiative of Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan has shaped India's maternal health journey over the past 10 years: Smt Annpurna Devi
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Women and Child Development

The visionary initiative of Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan has shaped India's maternal health journey over the past 10 years: Smt Annpurna Devi

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
09 JUN 2026 2:45PM by PIB Delhi

With reference to the  Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan,Union Minister of Women and Child Development ,Smt Annpurna Devi in a post on X said that every new life begins in the mother's womb, and every stage of pregnancy has the right to safe, healthy and respectful care. Over the past decade, the
Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
 has made  safe motherhood a mass movement by providing timely health checkups, expert consultations, and improved maternal health services to millions of pregnant women. This is not just a scheme, but the Government's commitment to a healthy future for every mother and her unborn child. This visionary initiative has shaped India's maternal health journey over the past 10 years and become  the medium of positive change in the lives of lakhs of mothers.

#10YearsOfPMSurakshitMatritva

हर नई ज़िंदगी की शुरुआत माँ की कोख से होती है, और गर्भावस्था का प्रत्येक चरण सुरक्षित, स्वस्थ एवं सम्मानजनक देखभाल का अधिकार रखता है।
प्रधानमंत्री सुरक्षित मातृत्व अभियान ने पिछले एक दशक में करोड़ों गर्भवती महिलाओं तक समय पर स्वास्थ्य जांच, विशेषज्ञ परामर्श और बेहतर मातृ…
